question: Who can register to play?
answer: Residents of the society only, age 14 and above on the auction date.
help: e.g. Residents of the society only, age 16+, max 2 guest players per team

question: How are captains and vice-captains chosen?
answer: Captains and vice-captains are chosen by the sports committee before the auction.
help: e.g. Chosen by the sports committee. Their prices are set above; mark them in the players CSV (allotted_team, allotted_as)

question: Any players every team must have?
answer: Every team must have at least 1 wicket-keeper (enforced by the app).
help: e.g. At least 1 junior (under 16) and 1 senior (45+). Enforce with a pool min_per_team

question: Any limit on players from the same wing / tower / family?
answer: At most 4 players from the same wing per team (checked by the auctioneer).
help: e.g. Max 4 players from the same wing per team (checked by the auctioneer)

question: How are the reserve players (squad beyond the playing side) used?
answer: Any 8 of the 10 may play a match; the captain names the playing 8 before the toss.
help: e.g. Any squad player may play; the playing 8 is told to the umpire before the toss

question: What happens to players still unsold at the end?
answer: Players still unsold go by lottery to teams below 10 players, at base price.
help: e.g. Lottery to teams short of players, at base price

question: What if a bought player drops out before the tournament?
answer: If a bought player drops out, the team picks a replacement from the unsold players at base price.
help: e.g. The team picks a replacement from the unsold players at base price

question: Are trades between teams allowed after the auction?
help: e.g. No trades

question: Bidding conduct
answer: Bid only from the app or by paddle. No bids after the auctioneer says sold.
help: e.g. Bids only via the app or paddle; no bids after the hammer; no proxy bidding
